statement: The function returns a result r and vals(r) is the nondecreasing rearrangement of vals(head): (1) len(vals(r)) = n; (2) for every i with 0 <= i < len(vals(r))-1, vals(r)[i] <= vals(r)[i+1]; (3) for every integer x, the number of occurrences of x in vals(r) equals the number of occurrences of x in vals(head).
preconditions: Write vals(l) for the sequence of values of the Cons nodes of a finite List l, from head to tail. Let n = len(vals(head)). Assume 1 <= n <= 5000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, -5000 <= vals(head)[i] <= 5000.
